all.src: Bullish trigger required: price above the 50-day SMA AND 20-day SMA slope positive, or a defined breakout above the 20-day high
Short put at 0.20-0.25 delta; short call at the target price (measured move or 20-day ATR x 2 above spot)
DTE 30-60, no earnings inside the expiry

OI >= 500, spread <= 10% of mid on all four legs

management.src: Take profit at 60% of max profit

exits.src: Force-close by 15:45 ET on expiration day, always
Close the put vertical immediately if the short put goes ITM by more than 0.25 x Wp, or its delta <= -0.85, or its extrinsic < $0.10
Ex-dividend guard on the short call
